ratios.quote: At September 30, 2026, the Leverage Ratio was 1.14 under the revolving credit facility.

parsed.notes: Limit of 3.75 to 1.00 applies except during an Increased Leverage Period (as defined in the agreement), when a higher limit may apply. The 3.78% senior notes have substantially similar financial covenants, but the ratio reported is for the revolving credit facility. The debt-to-total-capitalization percentage (30.1%) is not a covenant and is excluded.
